finding.comment: The job slot is cleared before the worker lookup; on an unknown worker the job reference is already consumed and the job is silently dropped rather than retried — consume-before-validate.

files.patch:
--- a/worker/pool.py
+++ b/worker/pool.py
@@ -21,6 +21,10 @@
     def dispatch(self, name):
+        self.job = None
+        worker = self.workers.get(name)
+        if worker is None:
+            return
+        self.submit(worker)

rationale: beyond-original-scope probe: Python None semantics instead of null equality
